summary: (1) D1 is still open: the only named route-resolution primitive is fetch-oriented and does not observe pushInsteadOf; D2 is resolved by the role-keyed bidirectional classifier and orphan-only audit fixture (lines 119–136); D3 is resolved by the import-free descriptor module and missing/corrupt-artifact regeneration test (lines 79, 99–104). (2) The D1 fix itself introduces the sole new high-risk blocker; no other critical/high regression is supported.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: D1’s observer still does not resolve the route used by git push
findings.body: The design delegates route observation to callers but names `git ls-remote --get-url` as its primitive. Git’s own command help states that this expands only `url.<base>.insteadOf`; it does not apply `pushInsteadOf`. The correct push-oriented query is `git remote get-url --push --all origin`, which also enumerates multiple destinations. Because `isSafePushRoute` receives an already-computed singular `effectiveUrl`, its unit tests can pass synthetic foreign values without proving that callers observed the real push route; the only stated process harness covers `insteadOf`, not `pushInsteadOf`. Implemented from this design, a foreign `pushInsteadOf` can therefore remain invisible while init or secrets pushes a marker/scaffold or sealed-secret commit to the substituted repository.
findings.code:
판정 강도는 secrets 쪽(앵커드: `https://github.com/` · `git@github.com:` · `ssh://git@github.com/` + `.git` 허용, 중첩 금지)으로 수렴. owner·관측값 인자화로 identity.ts의 import-0 순수성을 보존한다. **관측은 호출자 소유다**: 구성 신원은 `remote.origin.url`을, 라우팅 안전은 `remote.origin.pushurl` 존재 여부와 insteadOf/pushInsteadOf 전개 결과(`git ls-remote --get-url`류)를 호출자가 수집해 인자로 넘긴다. push를 수행하는 두 동사(init·secrets)는 push 전에 ①·② 모두를 통과해야 한다(fail-closed) — origin.url만으로는 pushurl·rewrite 우회 경로에 봉인본·마커 커밋이 오귀속될 수 있음을 게이트 r1이 실증했다.

**seam 뒤로 들어가는 것**: host/scheme/중첩/.git/owner/app 판정 + push 라우팅 안전 판정 전부. **이동하는 콜사이트**: init.ts ensureClone(:230-234)·secrets.ts runAppSecrets(:114-117)이 술어 소비로 교체. git() 래퍼 중복(init.ts:53·secrets.ts:38)은 부수 정리.

**행동 변화(의도됨)**: init이 비표준 URL 형태(credential 포함 https, 포트 명시 ssh 등)와 우회 라우팅(pushurl·rewrite)에 fail-closed로 좁아진다 — 보안 술어로서 올바른 방향이고 기존 오류 문구("수동 확인 필요")가 이미 있다.

**테스트**: test_identity.bats류 단위 표면에 발산 축 전부를 핀(foreign-host 신규) + 적대 3축(foreign `pushurl` · `pushInsteadOf` · `insteadOf`) 신규. 기존 프로세스 경계 bats 하네스는 insteadOf로 canonical https URL을 로컬 bare에 매핑하므로, 라우팅 안전 검사는 **명시적 테스트 전용 주입**(하네스가 선언하는 우회 플래그) 뒤에서만 완화된다 — production 기본은 fail-closed이고, 하네스의 매핑을 production 술어가 조용히 통과시키는 경로는 두지 않는다.
findings.recommendation: Make push-route acquisition an explicit interface using `git remote get-url --push --all origin`, require every returned route to be canonical, and define handling for zero or multiple routes. Add process-boundary tests that configure real foreign `pushInsteadOf`, `insteadOf`, and multiple push URLs, proving the caller—not merely the pure predicate—observes and rejects them before either push.

next_steps: Correct D1’s observation primitive and add push-routing process tests; then triage this round-2 blocker.
